# NainDev Brandbook

> Official visual identity guide of the NainDev ecosystem: logo geometry, color palette with verified contrast ratios, typography, spacing and design principles. The page is written in Spanish; the design tokens are published as a standalone CSS file.

## Key links

- [Brandbook](https://brand.naindev.com/): the full brand guideline page (v1.5).
- [Design tokens](https://brand.naindev.com/tokens.css): CSS variables for the palette, typography and spacing.
- [Source repository](https://github.com/Nain9Dev/brandbook): brandbook source, tokens and ecosystem bar script.
- [NainDev](https://www.naindev.com/): main site of the NainDev ecosystem.
